episodes.title: Introduction and Definition of Communication
episodes.description: Explore how verbal and nonverbal cues create meaning and connect us with our surroundings.

episodes.title: Working Toward Competent Communication
episodes.description: Balance effective task completion with appropriate relationships to communicate competently in different situations.

episodes.title: Identity and Culture in Communication
episodes.description: Examine how identity and cultural expectations shape communication and help us interact more intentionally.

episodes.title: Perception
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss perception, the process of selecting, organizing, and interpreting information that helps us make sense of our environment.

episodes.title: Cross Cultural Communication Challenges
episodes.description: Explore visible and less obvious cultural assumptions that influence communication across and within cultures.

episodes.title: How Power Affects Communication
episodes.description: Use Hofstede’s work to examine power, cultural values, and their effects on everyday interactions.

episodes.title: Being Direct or Getting Emotional
episodes.description: Compare explicit messages with indirect communication that conveys meaning through implication.

episodes.title: What Is Your Conflict Style?
episodes.description: Compare conflict-management styles and consider how context affects the ways people respond to disagreements.

episodes.title: How is Language Built?
episodes.description: Explore language’s evolution, rules, and use of sounds, gestures, and symbols to create meaning.

episodes.title: How Verbal Communication affects Perception
episodes.description: Explore how language shapes thought and perception, including differences among people who speak different languages.

episodes.title: Listening
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss listening and the ways in which this process makes for richer communication.

episodes.title: Nonverbal Communication
episodes.description: Examine how body language and other nonverbal signals work alongside words to communicate meaning.

episodes.title: Nonverbal Cues and the Use of Space, Touch, and Time
episodes.description: In this episode, we discuss nonverbal cues and how the use of space, touch and time shape meaning and context in different cultures.

episodes.title: Creating and maintaining strong, healthy relationships
episodes.description: Use attraction theory to understand the forces that draw people together and help strengthen relationships.

episodes.title: Social Penetration Theory (Ogres Are Like Onions)
episodes.description: Use social penetration theory to understand self-disclosure, privacy, and growing closeness in relationships.

episodes.title: Creating Bonds: Knapp’s Relationship Development Model
episodes.description: Explore Knapp’s model of the stages through which relationships develop and move apart.

episodes.title: Relational Dialectics
episodes.description: Use relational dialectics to understand competing desires and the communication that maintains relationships.

episodes.title: Creating Healthy Relationships
episodes.description: Explore communication practices that support healthy relationships and strategies for managing conflict.

episodes.title: The Importance of Communication in the Workplace
episodes.description: Examine effective communication practices for workplace interactions, from customer conversations to persuasive recommendations.

episodes.title: Organizational Structure
episodes.description: Explore how organizational structure and job roles shape expectations for communication.

episodes.title: Impression Management and Self-Monitoring
episodes.description: Explore impression management: how people shape others’ perceptions through communication in different social contexts.

episodes.title: Business Apologies: How to spot the fakes
episodes.description: Examine how effective organizational apologies can help rebuild customer trust after mistakes.

episodes.title: Introducing Persuasion
episodes.description: Recognize persuasion in everyday messages and consider how understanding it can guide your choices.

episodes.title: Learning the Principles of Persuasion
episodes.description: Examine automatic responses, learned associations, and the role of social cues in persuasion.

episodes.title: The Ways We Can Be Swayed
episodes.description: Explore reciprocity, consistency, and scarcity while considering ethical responsibilities in persuasion.

episodes.title: History of Mass Media
episodes.description: Trace the evolution of mass media and its influence on news, culture, identity, and communication.

episodes.title: Why Do We Respond Differently to the Same Media?
episodes.description: Explore theories of media effects and how they help explain people’s reactions to the content they consume.

episodes.title: Why you’re a different version of yourself online
episodes.description: Explore theories explaining why behavior changes online and how those changes affect communication and relationships.

episodes.title: Two Sides of Social Media
episodes.description: Consider social media’s benefits, drawbacks, and influence on behavior and relationships.
